part.text:
The post "hello from the benchmark" is published. The Bluesky feed now shows it at the top from @bench.test, and a "Your post was sent" banner confirmed it.

Tapping and typing aren't available through `simctl`, so I used a small XCTest UI runner (built in `bench-tmp-yi6y2dzd/poster`) to send the taps, and used the shared simulator pasteboard for the text. Two side effects:
- The Bluesky app was relaunched during setup, so its previous session state was reset. It is still signed in as @bench.test.
- Safari opened a logged-out bsky.app page during a failed deep-link attempt. I left it alone; it's harmless.
